verdict.rationale: The evidence covers automation entry points: the CLI, headless batch mode, Build Automation, and AI Assistant workflows. None of it documents a way to version, review, or roll back the user's own automations. Build Automation's support for version control systems describes building from source repos. The Services API lifecycle policy covers Unity's own API versions, and Environments are data partitions; all of these are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
